# Jeremiah 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** The-word-of YHWH which came to Jeremiah concerning the-drought:

**2** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**3** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**4** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**5** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**6** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**7** "If our-iniquities testify against-us, YHWH, act for-the-sake-of Your-name; for many [are] our-apostasies — against-You we-have-sinned.

**8** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**9** Why are-You like-a-man confused, like-a-warrior [who]-cannot save? Yet-You [are] in-our-midst, YHWH, and-Your-name is-called upon-us — do-not-forsake-us!"

**10** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**11** And-YHWH said to-me, "Do-not-pray for this people for-good.

**12** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**13** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**14** And-YHWH said to-me, "Falsehood the-prophets are-prophesying in-My-name; I-did-not-send-them and-I-did-not-command-them and-I-did-not-speak to-them. A-vision-of falsehood and-divination and-worthlessness and-[the]-deceit-of their-heart they-are-prophesying to-you."

**15** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**16** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**17** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**18** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**19** Have-You-utterly-rejected Judah? Has-Your-soul loathed Zion? Why have-You-struck-us and-there-is-no healing for-us? Waiting for-peace but-there-is-no good, and-for-a-time-of healing but-behold — terror!

**20** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**21** And-YHWH declared concerning the-drought and-the-false-prophets and-the-suffering-of the-land.

**22** Are-there among-the-vanities-of the-nations those-causing-rain? Or-do the-heavens give showers? Is-it-not You, YHWH our-God? And-we-wait for-You, for You have-made all these.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **14:1**: Opening formula for the drought and false prophets oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **14:11**: Central imagery of dried cisterns — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **14:22**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
